hero.subtitle: Experience transformative dermatological treatments and restorative spa rituals, crafted with precision and delivered in an atmosphere of absolute tranquility.

features.title: Advanced Technology
features.desc: State-of-the-art dermatological equipment delivering precision treatments with measurable, lasting results.

features.title: Clinical-Grade Products
features.desc: Pharmaceutical-quality formulations, lab-tested and certified organic for maximum efficacy and safety.

features.title: Organic Philosophy
features.desc: Sulfate-free, paraben-free, cruelty-free. Only the purest botanical extracts and bioactive ingredients.

features.title: Expert Practitioners
features.desc: Board-certified dermatologists and licensed aestheticians with decades of combined expertise.

philosophy.body1: At Thera Derma, we exclusively use lab-tested, cruelty-free, and certified organic products. Our commitment to clean beauty ensures your skin receives only the purest ingredients for truly radiant, healthy results.
philosophy.body2: Every formulation is meticulously selected by our dermatologists, balancing the potency of clinical-grade actives with the gentleness of botanical extracts.

reasons.title: The Pinnacle of Technology
reasons.desc: State-of-the-art equipment delivers treatments with unparalleled accuracy, ensuring visible, lasting results from your very first visit.

reasons.title: The Touch of Mastery
reasons.desc: Our team comprises the most sought-after experts, each a master of their craft, dedicated to deeply restorative and personalized care.

reasons.title: An Oasis of Calm
reasons.desc: Every detail, from the ambient lighting to the serene music, is curated for your ultimate comfort and escape from the everyday.

items.name: Ananya Sharma
items.text: The Hydra Facial treatment was absolutely transformative. My skin has never looked this radiant. The entire experience, from the moment I walked in, was pure luxury.

items.name: Priya Desai
items.text: I've tried spas across the country, and Thera Derma is truly in a league of its own. The attention to detail, the products they use — everything is world-class.

items.name: Rahul Mehta
items.text: The Korean Head Spa was an experience I didn't know I needed. Incredibly relaxing and my scalp health has improved dramatically. Highly recommend.
